fields.name: 既有变曲率严格凸四次曲面

selection: Minimum full-domain E2 under both current paper-style P1 complete GPR3 binary-byte budget and native primitive count N. Full overhanging controls counted. P2 is selected from the fixed P1 bisection hierarchy under the same two budgets, not a globally optimal P2 mesh.
integration: Degree-exact five-node Gauss-Duffy integration of saved residual squared on the common physical square; independent seven-node release recheck. Float64, not interval proof.
baseline: Reuse immutable paper quartic metrics in rotated polynomial coordinates; L2 greedy region priority and L1 edge choice, no C0 closure. For the unrotated published polynomial every budget must match the prior paper report.
direction: Eigenvectors of analytic domain-mean Hessian. The local Hessian varies and may change its dominant direction. No noisy-DTM Hessian estimation claim.
reporting: Keep all 14 fields/rotations and 126 budget pairs, including losses and exact ties. This is a finite approximation-space and direction comparison, not a new P1 optimality theorem, original author numbers, or ArcGIS performance.
